defects.description: 'Forgot password?' link is positioned below social sign-in buttons instead of directly below the Sign In button as requested in turn 1. The social buttons were added below the sign-in button per turn 2, but the forgot password link should remain immediately under the primary sign-in action, not at the bottom of the stack.
defects.location: Bottom section, below Apple sign-in button

defects.description: Excessive vertical spacing between elements creates a disconnected, floating appearance. The 'Use Face ID' text is orphaned with too much space above and below, breaking the logical grouping of authentication methods.
defects.location: Between Sign In button and social buttons row

defects.description: Bottom trust badges ('FDIC Insured', '256-bit SSL') are partially cut off at the canvas edge, suggesting the frame is incorrectly cropped or the layout extends beyond intended bounds.
defects.location: Bottom edge of screen, trust badges row

defects.description: Google button uses a generic globe icon instead of the Google 'G' logo, failing industry-standard social sign-in conventions and reducing user recognition.
defects.location: Google 'Continue with Google' button, right side icon

defects.description: Apple button uses a generic phone/device icon instead of the Apple logo, similarly failing platform conventions for Apple Sign In.
defects.location: Apple 'Continue with Apple' button, right side icon

defects.description: The app icon/logo at top is an empty blue rounded square with no actual Vaultly branding or symbol—appears as a placeholder rather than finished asset.
Horizontal divider line below 'Don't have an account?' appears misaligned and extends awkwardly, not matching the width of the text above it.
defects.location: Bottom section, below account creation prompt

defects.description: The black Apple button against the dark navy background lacks sufficient contrast and visual separation, making it appear to bleed into the background.
